Example Open Merit Award

The Example Trust rewards curiosity and hard work wherever it is found, and has done so for many years.

The trustees read every essay themselves and choose the winners in a single sitting each spring.

Benefits

Each winner receives Rs. 5,000 once, along with a certificate signed by the trustees.

How to apply

Write to the trust with a short essay about a book you love and why it stayed with you.
